note: OpenVLA-OFT fine-tunes OpenVLA with parallel decoding, action chunking and continuous actions (L1 regression). Images are resized to 224 × 224 without keeping the aspect ratio (OpenVLA's "resize-naive") and, because training used random crops of 90 % of the area, the README says "Setting --center_crop True is important ... at test time we simply take the center 90% crop" (crop_side_fraction 0.9487 = √0.9 of each side). Each view gives "256 patch embeddings" from OpenVLA's two ViTs with 14 px patches. The timings are the paper's, on one NVIDIA A100. Code MIT; the base weights may carry the Llama 2 Community License. DexVantage bundles these figures only. The LIBERO recipe (Table IV): one third-person and one wrist image, chunk 8 executed open-loop; the latency 0.1120 s is Table II's last row (with the wrist image and robot state; one image only: 0.0729 s).
